Election Commission Responds to Voter List Controversy

The Election Commission (EC) has responded to questions raised regarding its voter list management, particularly concerning the removal and addition of voters. Congress leader Shashi Tharoor posed questions about the process, seeking answers related to Form 6 and the inclusion of 97 voters in Goa. The EC stated that differing views are part of its decision-making process and that decisions are made by consensus. The controversy arose following an investigation by The Indian Express into voter additions and deletions. The Goa CEO office clarified that while some names were removed, "some names were added" in response to an issue involving 97 voters.
